national.note: The IKO's official results list 'Marchin Prachino (Poland)' second at +90 kg. That is a misspelling of his name. His UFC bio ('2nd place European Championship Karate 2012') and a video of the final against Belkhodja agree. The Kyokushin Results almanac also lists a 2011 IKO Europeans (Padova) -90 kg bronze, which isn't recorded until the IKO's 2011 results are checked. The 2012 EKO (Antwerp) and WKO Shinkyokushin (Kielce) Europeans are separate organisations and don't list him.
